limitations: Diagnostic only: one round, five samples, one user and ten transaction records. No global application acceptance.
Payload byte comparison uses the same fixture. Full-account timing is MISS and option timing is HIT; these durations are not a controlled before/after latency comparison.
Release browser coverage is recorded separately. Native platforms and the official matrix remain pending.
Full backend integration is blocked by existing normalized-refunds expectations that conflict with the current excess-refund implementation; replay trigger cleanup then causes cascading failures.
